result.summary: Read git diff master...HEAD directly (11 files). Diff is scoped to exactly src/i18n/routing.ts (one-line array literal: locales now ["ru","uz","en","kk"], defaultLocale unchanged "ru") and messages/kk.json (new file), plus expected bookkeeping (docs/agents/design/REQ-005.md, requirements.yaml status flips to in_progress for REQ-005/REQ-006, requirement_status.yaml started-event appends, this run's handoff files, orchestrator.log append). No src/ file outside routing.ts touched; no CSS/component edit crept in; no stray file in project root. Independently verified messages/kk.json's key set against messages/ru.json with my own Node script (not trusting FRONTEND-DEV's report): both files have exactly 177 leaf keys, identical key set (0 missing, 0 extra), and every leaf value byte-identical to ru.json except Metadata.ogLocale, which is the literal placeholder "ru_RU" specified explicitly by the requirement text and design doc (docs/agents/design/REQ-005.md §3) -- confirmed intentional, not a defect. Independently re-ran npm run lint myself: 0 errors, 4 pre-existing warnings, all in files this diff does not touch (Avatar.jsx, Footer.tsx, Nav.tsx img-element/unused-var warnings) -- matches FRONTEND-DEV's report exactly. Checked against docs/Design system for AI agents/readme.md: no visual surface introduced (no CSS, no component, no token use) so tokens/type-scale/spacing/component-class/icon rules do not apply; no copy-casing concern since messages/kk.json content is an explicit verbatim-Russian placeholder pending REQ-006, not new authored copy. Checked against docs/agents/anti-patterns.md: neither logged anti-pattern (result.status/handoff-status conflation; clock-vs-memory timestamps) recurs in this diff -- result.status values throughout the run's handoff chain are legal, and this handoff's own timestamps were read from the clock. Checked against docs/agents/decisions/0002-content-ba-owns-message-catalogs.md: confirmed this decision governs REQ-006 (real Kazakh content), not REQ-005 -- REQ-005 is the structural/placeholder-seeding requirement mirroring REQ-001a (uz)/REQ-003 (en), both correctly done by FRONTEND-DEV with verbatim-source placeholders, exactly the same precedent this diff follows; requirements.yaml's REQ-005 owner is FRONTEND-DEV and REQ-006's owner is CONTENT-BA, consistent with the decision. No violation found. Non-blocking note: none beyond what's already logged upstream (the four pre-existing lint warnings, unrelated to this diff, already known).
